title: Lumbar disc units in axial compression - Brown, Hansen, Yorra 1957 (JBJS 39A:1135) MIN and MAX curves (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020a Fig 4a)
condition: as in primary (not given in secondary source)

quantity.name: axial compression force-displacement curve
quantity.definition: axial compressive force vs axial displacement; softest (MIN) and stiffest (MAX) specimen curves as plotted by Ghezelbash 2020a

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Shirazi-Adl A, Baghani M, Eskandari AH
source.sample: not stated in the secondary source (see primary: Brown T, Hansen RJ, Yorra AJ 1957, JBJS Am 39:1135-1164, doi 10.2106/00004623-195739050-00014); human lumbar (lumbosacral) disc-vertebra specimens tested in compression; Ghezelbash 2020a groups them with intact motion segments

protocol.summary: Compression tests of lumbar disc specimens (Brown et al. 1957); loading rate, preload and specimen preparation not given in the secondary source.
how_to_simulate: Model a lumbar disc with adjacent vertebral bodies
Apply axial compression slowly from zero load
Report the force at each displacement and check it lies between the MIN and MAX curves
protocol.notes: Secondary data: digitised from a figure of Ghezelbash et al. 2020a (the owner's FE validation band; also Fig 2c of Ghezelbash 2025 bioRxiv). Primary paper not in the repository. Specimen type (disc-body unit vs motion segment) and n must be checked in the primary paper.

extraction.from: Ghezelbash 2020a Fig 4a (green dashed = MIN, green solid = MAX); same data form the 'Experiment' band of Ghezelbash 2025 bioRxiv Fig 2c
extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.01 mm, +/-30 N; where curves overlap below 0.3 mm: +/-60 N
extraction.check_notes: Page rendered at 600 dpi; axes from tick marks (831 px/mm, 0.302 px/N); curves found by colour (green = Brown, red = Markolf & Morris, lime squares = Asano) in column scans every 0.025-0.1 mm, line style (solid/dashed/dash-dot) assigned by continuity and checked against a gridded zoom. Values are the review authors' plot of the primary data, not the primary paper.

pass_rule.rule: model curve inside the min-max envelope (or within +/-25% of the curve)
